description: Nightcall: while a night run is on (see /nightcall:start), a finished turn is sent back to the next step instead of stopping. Off by itself at the end time, on MORNING.md, or on a STOP file in the task folder. The hook goes through hooks/python.sh (step 0 guard): without a real Python 3 it does nothing and never pops Apple's developer-tools window.
